candidates.title: Gather agent session notes on one canvas

demandEvidence.chore: Keep track of several agent sessions that are scattered across separate tools.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I often have several agent sessions open at once, but they're all scattered across

ease.reason: A four-week mock can organize operator-supplied sample sessions, but the discussion documents no accessible integration or workflow tool.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent teams coordinating several agent sessions might pay for a shared workspace; the post proves no buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A prototype can group fictional session notes on one canvas; connecting live agents, tools and teammates is unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed view could collect supplied session notes, while a person chooses what to share and resolves conflicting updates.

evidence.reason: The builder describes several sessions being scattered across tools, but supplies no recurrence, task detail or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed a small shared view from operator-supplied sample session notes. Its provisional mean is 4.6, below threshold, and the specific customer overlaps recent post 0d455200b5ff2b5b39d4eac6 (teams operating AI agents).

candidates.title: Notify a restaurant about new orders

demandEvidence.chore: Notify a restaurant when a new order is placed on its website.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .

ease.reason: A beginner can test operator-entered sample orders and prepare a short alert; the discussion names Make.com but documents no trigger or WhatsApp capability.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent restaurant operators might pay for alert setup; this request establishes a need, not buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can map supplied order examples into alert drafts; live website intake, delivery and reliability remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed repeatable order-to-draft loop is narrow, but a person must verify each order and approve any real message.

evidence.reason: The request explicitly asks to automate restaurant order notifications, but gives no frequency, input fields or corroborating implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow mock that turns operator-supplied sample orders into notification drafts. Its provisional mean is 5.0, below threshold; live order intake and WhatsApp delivery are not evidenced.
